name: Suffuse
author: Erin Carter
description: A pastel wash that bleeds into itself — wide soft poles of opal blue, lilac, rose and mint drift so slowly they read as one suffused field, with a faint soap-bubble shimmer sweeping through. The softest, dreamiest member of the family.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How slowly the pastel poles wander; 0 holds the wash almost still.

params.label: Bleed
params.effect: How wide the poles bleed; high merges everything into one soft wash, low keeps colour regions distinct.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Strength of the iridescent soap-bubble sheen riding over the colour.

params.label: Drift warp
params.effect: Organic distortion of the colour edges; low is glassy, high adds gentle folds.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
